title: The shop is open — Cookie Sparkles for everyone
summary: Explore the shop, equip your free lobby trail, and choose optional cosmetics without competitive advantages.
body:
- Visit /shop on the website or use /shop in game. The old /cosmetics links and command still work.
- Cookie Sparkles (Étincelles de cookie) is free for every player: equip this little lobby trail without a purchase or subscription. Java and Bedrock are supported; rendering can vary by client.
- Link your player with /support link to equip your free trail from your web inventory. No payment card is needed.
- Optional permanent cosmetics and the Supporter subscription at €1 per month are available in the shop. Existing purchases and access remain available.
- Playing remains free. Purchases provide no competitive advantage in minigames.
